label: Étendard civil de clan
function: Signal de cour, d'archives ou de fret posé sur une base lestée ; aucune faction ou quête ajoutée
lore: Ornement original de clan, pas un emblème officiel ni la preuve d'une institution canonique
prompt: Create one single isolated native 2.5D GAME SPRITE: a civilian Yautja clan banner standard, one rigid weathered dark bronze pole fixed into a single broad solid octagonal basalt weighted foot, a compact deep scarlet woven banner suspended on a bronze crossbar. The cloth has discreet abstract geometric clan ornament only, not readable lettering, not an existing official emblem, no human skulls, no people, no weapons. ORIGINAL LORE-FRIENDLY GAME PROP, not claimed to be canonical. Strict parallel orthographic camera, yaw 0 degrees, pitch 35 degrees; a natural slight LEFT-facing diagonal is built into the object, no perspective converging lines, entire object including all corners of its connected stable foot fully visible. Weathered charcoal basalt, dark bronze metal, muted scarlet textile, warm upper-left light, crisp carefully crafted high-detail hand-painted HD 2D/3D sprite aesthetic, same restrained ancient alien civic material palette as a Yautja city. Moderate practical civil standard, not a monumental temple. Target native total projected height 120 game world units, foot roughly 35 x 28 world units. A legible solid base with clear contact boundary, rigid pole, only one joined asset. True transparent background with transparent empty margins all around, no backdrop, no floor or cast shadow outside the object, no outer glow, no mist, no atlas, no collage, no labeling. Square 1024 x 1024 image, keep 12 percent margin.
review: Single complete standard, textile attached to rigid crossbar and pole with one weighted octagonal base; decorative still sprite, not a cloth animation
